topic: Guard files need SP-042's shell-write protection
detail: SP-041's snapshot (<data>/guard/policy.json) and pin files are protected from file tools only (the guard directory is the snapshot's one protected path). A shell write (echo, tee, cp, mv, sed -i) can still set the guard's switch to off in the snapshot or change a session's pin space, and an edit of orch.db can do the same for the fallback. SP-042 must cover <data>/guard and orch.db for shell writes, and should keep reads of the pin files allowed.
